name: Danang International Marathon 2027
short_description: A road race in Da Nang, Vietnam on Sunday 21 March 2027, with full marathon, half marathon and 10 km options, starting and finishing at East Sea Park on Vo Nguyen Giap Street.
ai_summary: The Danang International Marathon 2027 takes place on Sunday 21 March 2027 in Da Nang, Vietnam, organised by Pulse Active with the city's Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism. It offers a full marathon (42.195 km, 3am start), a half marathon (21 km, 4.30am) and a 10 km (5.30am), all starting and finishing at East Sea Park on Vo Nguyen Giap Street, An Hai ward. The 10 km returns for 2027; the 2026 edition offered 42 km, 21 km and 5 km.

core_facts.organizer: Pulse Active with the Da Nang Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism
core_facts.venue: East Sea Park (Bien Dong Park), Vo Nguyen Giap Street, An Hai ward

pros: Flat, certified course along My Khe Beach, the Han River and the bay
Stations every 2 km with water, electrolyte drink and toilets
Seven-hour marathon limit suits slower runners
Large international field: 1,269 marathon finishers in 2026
cons: 24°C and 94% humidity at the 3am start in 2026
One steep climb over Thuan Phuoc Bridge at about 33 km
Four intermediate marathon cut-offs that require about 10 minutes per kilometre
Entry fees for foreigners of up to 2,200,000 VND for the marathon

faqs.question: When is the Danang International Marathon 2027 taking place?
faqs.answer: Sunday 21 March 2027, according to the organiser's 2027 race information page. The marathon starts at 3am, the half marathon at 4.30am and the 10 km at 5.30am, with the final marathon cut-off at 10am. The 2026 edition, the 13th, was held on 22 March 2026.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at this race?
faqs.answer: Three: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21 km and a 10 km, which returns for 2027 after two years away. The 2026 edition offered the marathon, the half marathon and a 5 km instead. The marathon has a seven-hour limit counted from gun time.

faqs.question: Where is the Danang International Marathon 2027 held?
faqs.answer: At East Sea Park (Bien Dong Park) on Vo Nguyen Giap Street, An Hai ward, Da Nang, which is the start and finish for all distances and the race-kit pick-up area. In 2026 the marathon course ran along My Khe Beach, the Han River and the bay, crossing Thuan Phuoc Bridge.

source_mix.label: Báo Đà Nẵng report on the 2026 edition (organisers)
